messages:
emma: Heads-up — noticing an APAC surge this morning. SFDC handoffs are backing up; round-robin is ignoring timezone and enrichment lag is ~20-30m. Can we sketch a short-term plan (overflow pool + timezone-aware routing) to keep SLAs intact?

raj: +1. Metrics look bad between 00:00-08:00 PST. If we don't split by region we'll keep tripping the daily capacity.

mia: Agree. Proposal: create an "overflow pool" (temporary sales queue) that only receives leads outside EMEA/NAM business hours. Backfill enrichment async and tag lead with "enrich_pending" so sales sees context.

sam-sales: How would ownership work? We can't assign enterprise ACV to that pool. We need rules: enterprise leads always route to on-call owner immediately, non-enterprise go to overflow.

olivia: +1 on enterprise carve-out. Also add a short TTL: if enrichment hasn't completed in 15m, escalate to sales-oncall via Slack alert and push to priority queue.

emma: Rough SLA targets to validate: 95% of enterprise handoffs < 5m, 90% of non-enterprise handoffs < 10m (including enrichment backfill). If enrichment not done in 15m then fallback to minimal payload + assign.

raj: Implementation sketch for HubSpot workflow (pseudo):
```
IF: lead.source IN (inbound-form, demo-request)
AND: lead.geo_region = APAC
AND: lead.account_tier != enterprise
THEN: set lead.owner = overflow_pool_ozone
SET: lead.properties.enrich_status = pending
TRIGGER: async_enrichment_job(lead_id)
```
We can flip a feature flag for the workflow to 10% for canary.

mia: Canary plan: route 10% APAC -> overflow for 2 hours, monitor: handoff_time, enrich_latency, lead-loss. If metrics stable, ramp 25% next day. Rollback path: revert workflow and run assignment-backfill job.

sam-sales: Need to update SF assignment rules too so on-call enterprise owners still get routed. I can draft the SF rule. Also want a quick UI note for SDRs explaining the "enrich_pending" tag.

olivia: I'll add dashboard widgets in Looker: handoff_time by region, enrich_latency P50/P95, assigned_queue_count, and leads escalated.

emma: Quick product/security check: are there PII concerns if we push partial payload to sales before enrichment? @security-squad flagged earlier.

raj: From what I recall, partial payload (email + company + form text) is ok. No sensitive fields should be pushed until enrichment completes. Add a filter to strip sensitive props in the workflow.

sam-sales: Also add a quality gate: if enrichment fails twice, mark lead as 'needs-manual-review' and put into a low-volume queue for inbox review.

olivia: HubSpot automation note (actual action to run): create workflow "overflow_ozone_canary_v1", set enrollment = APAC + not enterprise, enrollment throttle = off, and add property update + webhook to async_enrich service.

emma: I'll open the change request and set the feature-flag. Link to approach doc: https://redwood-internal/marketing/ozone-overflow (draft).

hubspot-bot: Workflow created: overflow_ozone_canary_v1 (id: wf_2026_089). Enrollment criteria saved.

mia: After canary we should run a 24h audit: sample 200 APAC leads and check if any were mis-routed or lost. Also compare conversion rates pre/post.

sam-sales: I'll prepare the SDR note and a 1-pager for AE handoff expectations. Also scheduling a 15m sync with ops at 10:30 PT.

emma: Thanks team. Action items: raj to flip flag for 10% canary; mia to monitor metrics; olivia to add dashboards; sam to update SF rules + SDR note. We'll reconvene after 2h canary or sooner if alerts fire. :thumbsup:

raj: Starting canary now. Flag = ON. Will post metrics snapshot in #marketing in 30m.

hubspot-bot: Enrollment count: 42 leads (canary 10%) in first 12m.

olivia: Dashboard ready and linked in the doc. First 15m P95 handoff_time = 4.2m, enrich_latency P95 = 12m.

sam-sales: Noted — still under SLA for enterprise carve-out. No sales tickets yet.

emma: Great. If anyone sees an unexpected spike, @emma please ping immediately and we'll kill the flag.

mia: Logging retrospective checklist to the doc: post-mortem if >5% increase in lead-loss, update onboarding if SDR confusion >2 tickets per day, and permanent routing plan if canary sustained 48h.

raj: Can we add a tiny script to backfill owner for any leads that were incorrectly sent to overflow? Example: `python tools/backfill_owner.py --since 1769876400 --queue overflow_ozone`

sam-sales: Good idea. Keep me looped on backfill run.

emma: Closing thread for now — followups in the doc + 10:30 sync notes.
